data.text: Good, I can see the order_status field has 8 distinct values. Now let me run a SQL query to count orders by each status.

args.purpose: Count total orders by each order_status value (all orders, no filter)
args.sql:
SELECT order_status, COUNT(*) as order_count
FROM orders
GROUP BY order_status
ORDER BY order_count DESC
